_note: The catalog of the specialist agents (id148, or55; the senior training, id149, or56): one profile per role, pure data with no vendor names, so the same role rules any engine. The guard (server/chat/guard.mjs) holds each role: the kind tag picks the role, the role line (with the method) rides the brief, the entry gates refuse a vague brief, and inside the agent only the role's tools may run and only its skills may open. kinds: every kind of server/ai/policy.json belongs to exactly one role (checked by test/agents-catalog.test.mjs). tools: the hook-visible tools the role may use (Read, Glob and Grep are read-only and never reach the hook; every other tool is denied). skills: the skills the role may open, and the brief must still name the skill (or32). method: the role's fixed senior working method, from the research of 2026-10-15 (research_notes/Agentes seniores/). deliver: what the role must hand over before its work is accepted.
